title: Buzz documentation corpus relationship types
description: The finite relationship-type enum a corpus node's `relationships` array may use. `relationshipMeta` (below the JSON Schema keywords) is not itself a validation rule -- it is the directionality/inverse metadata issue #622's done-when requires per relationship type, read by tooling and by launchpad/docs/corpus/schema/tests/test_schema.py, which asserts every enum member here has a matching entry.

target.description: The stable id (node.schema.json's `id`) of the related node.

depends-on.directionality: source requires target to be true/current for source's own claims to hold

supersedes.directionality: source replaces target; target becomes historical

implements.directionality: source is the concrete realization of target (e.g. a template instance of a standard)

references.directionality: source cites target as supporting context; no ownership or currency dependency implied

part-of.directionality: source is a constituent section/child of target
